subjectFilter.description: Subject filter used for {@link MlModel} operation.

title:
Captures the inputs used for {@link MlModel} operations.
Note: List of individual subjects used for feature evaluation is not captured.
It is recommended that users invoke {@link MlModel} APIs that accepts subject filter as input.
Alternatively, if a list of subjects must be captured during {@link MlModel#train}, then it is recommended to
provide {@link MlOperationSpec#xSnapshotIds} and {@link MlOperationSpec#ySnapshotIds} after invoking
{@link Feature.Set#createSnapshot}
name: MlModel.Input
